ios.clause: The sole new production file exports the exact native API in API.md, owns its DTOs and product helpers, and compiles against the existing iOS 14 / Compose platform without new dependencies.
Initial state, same-snapshot recomposition and changed-request reset follow README; state lives inside the production component rather than the bridge.
Selection uses caller option IDs, respects availability, preserves caller order, and selecting a different option clears acceptance.
Servings change by one within the selected inclusive bounds; selection and new bounds clamp the current desired count; controls disable without a choice and after send.
Integer-cent replacement total and signed balance use current price, prepaid amount and applied credit; refund, zero and payment formatting follow README exactly.
Credit starts off, is independently editable only for positive credit before send, clears acceptance on edits, and becomes off when a new snapshot has zero credit.
Acceptance is bound to current selection, servings, credit and balance, is unavailable without a valid choice, and gates send together with the unsent state.
A different revision on the same request reconciles the current choice and count with all new input fields, clears acceptance/sent, and does not force component recreation.
Only a valid send emits one typed current MenuChangeSubmission and then prevents resending that revision; all edit and caller-update paths are callback silent.
All native system font base sizes and weights match /style/typography and scale with the caller font environment using iOS-14-compatible APIs without capping the approved scale.
The source applies /style/layout root/card/section/paragraph/footer gaps and radii in native units, uses non-scrolling vertical content, and gives text no line limit or fixed text height.
Choice, quantity and send minimum dimensions and send padding follow /style/layout, on the actual native controls, while allowing vertical growth with scaled text.
The source chooses every light/dark role at /style/colors for the canvas, surfaces, ink, notice, selection and enabled/disabled send; it does not attenuate the complete unavailable row.
The source uses native leading/trailing direction without reversing caller arrays or forcing a text direction; quantity and currency strings preserve their required ASCII representation.

The production targets listed in API.md have unique IDs/tags, current labels, option selection semantics and actual single native button/switch descendants; no hidden duplicate UI or test style readback is added.
The bridge only decodes the current fixture fields into the fixed production DTO and forwards the production typed submission wireValue, without reimplementing product derivation.
The bridge directly calls the imported production MenuChangeReviewPanel at a stable call site, without a cloned UI, product state holder, .id or keyed reconstruction.

initial_findings_and_fix.initial_classification: product hypothesis supported by original PNG and source; D2 and Final confirm the chosen correction removes the sampled fill mismatch
initial_findings_and_fix.change: Private MenuReviewButtonStyle returns the custom label without extra system disabled attenuation; used at the option, quantity and send Button sites. Actual disabled behavior remains. No business-state or Android change.
initial_findings_and_fix.final_status: All six original sampled iOS send-fill atoms pass in fresh Final; unavailable-row content stays full-opacity and legible.

preserved_infrastructure_failure.reason: Root scheduler supplied cycle JSON as native --previous, which requires capture/result.json; frozen tool rejected safely. D2 used the correct original receipt.
preserved_infrastructure_failure.evidence_limit: Dispatch details are root-provided; A does not claim an absent D1 native screenshot.

limits: This is the implementer self assessment for the independently defined public eight-state path. Independent judgment may disagree; no hidden evaluation was read or predicted.

Seventeen source/bridge obligations per platform are exact manual current-source observations. The supplied frozen Skill has no source-responsibility binding CLI; no computed SwiftUI style or extra tool gate is claimed.

Native geometry measures accessibility/control boxes. Screenshot atoms establish only approved sampled regions or qualitative aspects, not whole-app navigation, keyboard behavior, physical Android touch, real network delivery or arbitrary unseen environments.
D0 and D2 evidence remain original records. D0 machine failures were not rewritten; D2 diagnostic images do not certify the Final capture.

All production source remained unchanged after diagnostic 1 dispatch and after the edit deadline; Final review only bound fresh raw observations and closed original final cycles without SDK execution.
